newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 233 OF SEPTEMBER 14, 1996.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 233 OF SEPTEMBER 14, 1996.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

Corrigendum to Council Regulation (EC) No 1427/96 of 26 June 1996 amending Regulation (EEC) No 2392/89 laying down general rules for the description and presentation of wines and grape musts (Official Journal of the European Communities No L 184 of 24 July 1996)

Corrigendum to Commission Regulation (EC) No 1179/96 of 27 June 1996 opening a standing invitation to tender for the export of barley held by the German intervention agency (Official Journal of the European Communities No L 155 of 28 June 1996)
COMMISSION DECISION of 29 May 1996 concerning State aid to Walzwerk Ilsenburg GmbH (Only the German text is authentic) (Text with EEA relevance) (96/544/ECSC)

COMMISSION DECISION of 30 April 1996 ordering the Italian Government to supply all the documentation, information and data on aid for restructuring the road haulage sector and to suspend forthwith the payment of any further aid (Only the Italian text is authentic) (Text with EEA relevance) (96/543/EC)

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1788/96 of 13 September 1996 fixing the maximum buying-in price and the quantities of beef to be bought in under the 167th partial invitation to tender as a general intervention measure pursuant to Regulations (EEC) No 1627/89 and (EC) No 1680/96
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1787/96 of 13 September 1996 fixing the import duties in the cereals sector
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1786/96 of 13 September 1996 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1785/96 of 13 September 1996 on the supply of white sugar as food aid
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1784/96 of 13 September 1996 on the supply of milk products as food aid

COUNCIL REGULATION (Euratom, ECSC, EC) No 1783/96 of 11 September 1996 laying down the weightings applicable from 1 January 1996 to the remuneration of officials of the European Communities serving in third countries END OF DOCUMENT.
